content: Goal: inspect the workspace and prior-round traces before choosing an idea. Read: workspace listing and progress.jsonl. Observed: only progress.jsonl exists and it is empty; no repository code or earlier proposals are available, so novelty must be argued against the round summaries in the prompt. Reasoning: the prior selected ideas occupy successor-Fréchet codebook updates, feedback curvature per RQ level, and behaviour-ranked radial Poincare assignment. To avoid those, I chose a different coupling position: a fixed training-only transition-spectral vector is used as a Mobius translation of the residual query inside every RQ assignment, so behaviour changes the curved codebook partition itself rather than the codebook centroid, per-level curvature or radial bias. Open: final block still to be recorded.

Goal: select a distinct coupling position for a hyperbolic + training-only-behaviour SID mechanism. Read: workspace root listing requested; earlier-round selected ideas are Poincare-Frechet successor codebook updates, per-level feedback curvature, and behaviour-ranked radial Poincare assignment. Observation: those occupy codebook update, curvature control, and radial assignment; a remaining clean position is a behaviour-marginal curved optimal-transport assignment at each RQ level. Open: verify repository for existing OT/Sinkhorn code and avoid copying.
